title: Pre-Construction Termite Treatment in Goa
intro: Protect your new building in Goa from termite infestation with professional pre-construction anti-termite treatment. For a new Goa villa, apartment building or hospitality project, soil treatment visits are coordinated with the foundation and flooring schedule while the relevant zones remain accessible.

definition: Pre-construction anti-termite treatment is a preventive process carried out during construction to help protect your building from subterranean termites. processTitle: Our pre-construction termite treatment process in Goa
processIntro: A clear plan for Goa properties, from the first conversation to agreed aftercare.
steps: Treat the bottom and sides of foundation trenches. Coordinate access to the excavated foundation trenches with your Goa builder before they are covered.
